contentText: First, Uganda is heading for the exit in eastern DR Congo. Kampala has announced the withdrawal of its troops from a key town in North Kivu, as relations with Kinshasa deteriorate following provocative comments from Uganda's army chief. Then, pregnant women are struggling to cope with extreme heat, while health experts warn of growing risks for unborn babies, from dehydration to premature births. And, after seeking safety, opportunity and a better life, many migrants in South Africa now face hostility, violence and growing exclusion. As anti-immigration sentiment gains ground, the country's promise is fading for those who once saw it as a land of hope.
